items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Tommy Benford, but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond or provide any personal connection.

ctx.x: That's a name for a drummer.
Yup, Cripple Smitty, good drummers. Tommy Benford, of course he's still playing.
I heard him a couple of years ago, he sounds great.
